types.ts: integer in the unit and origin of the timestamp rule named by rule

operations.name: now
operations.doc: Current time under the default timestamp rule.

operations.name: rule
operations.doc: The timestamp rule by id; id omitted resolves to the catalog default.

operations.name: mono
operations.doc: Monotonic counter for durations on one machine; not an event time. Added after the trail row check (ms field).

operations.name: next_tick
operations.doc: Next epoch-pinned tick: the next multiple of interval after from (floored epoch multiple), no timer.

cost: one record, a binding per kind, a timestamp rule record; mono is a fourth operation added by a real shape

types.frame: bytes | members; members is a list of {id, version} with count and cursor (enumerable result set)

operations.name: open

in.protocol: id? (omitted resolves to the catalog default per layer)

operations.doc: Open an exchange; names at most one protocol per layer.

operations.name: read
operations.doc: Next frame; bytes, or members when the protocol record declares an enumerable result.

operations.name: write
operations.doc: Send bytes under the stream's protocol.

operations.name: close
operations.doc: End the exchange.

emits: one event record per call, with protocol id and the delegation used
cost: every ingress needs a protocol record; no ambient request API; frame kind members needs stable ids from the far side (PH6)

types.key: {ns, id, dim?} where dim names a reader or view
types.version: {key, at, seq, prev?, by, value | tomb}; never overwritten

operations.name: put
operations.doc: Append a version; expect makes it compare-and-set on the declared version.

operations.name: read
operations.doc: As-of read: the version with the greatest at <= given, ties by seq; at omitted means now.

operations.name: list
operations.doc: Enumerable result set of keys under a prefix as of a time.

operations.name: void
operations.doc: Tombstone version used by knockout; nothing is deleted.

operations.name: policy
operations.doc: Retention, compaction and size caps for a namespace; never a constant in code.

cost: memory for all versions; retention data; prev (predecessor link) added after the catalog line check because the catalog orders by supersedes and file position, not time

types.patch: nodes added, changed, removed, each with look rule ids
types.event: event record (time.md): id, source, start, transitions, payload, rule

operations.name: apply
operations.doc: Change the node tree.

operations.name: look
operations.doc: Select a look record (CSS-like rules).

operations.name: draw
operations.doc: Draw by a shader spec on the settled baseline (hypothesis, Q11).

operations.name: events
operations.doc: Input as event records; a press-drag-release gesture is one record.

binding_kinds: js-edge (only if Q2 is a browser layer or a webview surface)
cost: tied to one graphics baseline; accessibility tree not yet an operation and likely needed early (README flag); none of the ten real shapes exercises this contract except the approval prompt of a concern

types.module: id of a loaded component by digest

operations.name: load
operations.doc: Load a wasm component; the only door for code.

operations.name: instantiate
operations.doc: Link by contract id and version; an import not granted is unmet.

operations.name: call
operations.doc: Call an export; an operation record is also what a model-facing tool definition is (name, doc, in, out, errors).

operations.name: unload
operations.doc: Release an instance.

emits: one event record per call, with the digest
cost: the embedder or layer owns the wasm engine (Q2); versioning of every contract it links

types.delegation: {id, principal, scope[{contract, op}], constraints, created_at, revoked_at}

operations.name: principal
operations.doc: Who the app acts for.

operations.name: delegate
operations.doc: Create a delegation; needs the principal's own act (a surface prompt), never an ingested instruction.

operations.name: check
operations.doc: Allow or deny one call, naming the record and clause.

operations.name: provenance
operations.doc: Source, protocol, time and parent of a datum.

operations.name: issue_id
operations.doc: Platform-issued opaque id, recorded in an event record so replay reuses it. Added after the handle check (random mint).

operations.name: revoke
operations.doc: End a delegation.

cost: provenance on every value; delegation prompts; a threat entry per contract added; issue_id is the least certain home (an entropy source may deserve its own place)
